title: Filter the web list by priority
probes: The one case where BE must land before FE. A correct PO splits this into two dev sub-tasks linked `depends_on`; a lazy one merges them and the FE half has nothing to call.
description:
As a todo user I want to see only my high-priority items so that I can work the top of the list.

The web server already supports `?tag=`; add `?priority=`:

- `visibleTodos` must accept a `priority` option and filter on it, rejecting anything that is not high/normal/low.
- `GET /api/todos?priority=high` and the HTML page must both honour it.
- The HTML page needs a way to switch priority without hand-editing the URL.

The filter behaviour has to be settled and tested before the page can use it.
